kip.definition:
n. sleep
n. the basic unit of money in Laos
n. a gymnastic exercise performed starting from a position with the legs over the upper body and moving to an erect position by arching the back and swinging the legs out and down while forcing the chest upright
kip.translation:
n. 小牛皮, 小客栈, 吊床, 千磅
vi. 住客栈

kip down.translation: 在某处过夜, 在（自己的床以外的地方）睡觉

kipling.definition: n. English author of novels and poetry who was born in India (1865-1936)
kipling.translation: n. 吉卜林（姓氏）；吉卜林（英国作家, 1865-1936, 1907年获诺贝尔文学奖）

kiplingesque.definition: a in the manner of Rudyard Kipling
kiplingesque.translation: a. 吉卜林格调的, 吉卜林文体的

kipped.translation: v. 在某处过夜, 在（自己的床以外的地方）睡觉( kip的过去式和过去分词 )

kippered.translation: 熏制的(指咸鲑鱼或鲱鱼)

kippered herring.translation:
na. 熏鲱鱼

kippered salmon.translation: [网络] 开背冷熏大麻哈鱼
